policy: Finite optional teaching gaps within the evaluated pilot units. Approval for authoring does not approve future bytes or claim physical playthrough. Exact pilot-pattern variations require origin proof plus independent music/language/parser review; new patterns remain drafts until human review. No automatic units, required placements or repeated quota content.

gaps.objective: Identify a ringing rest in your own eight-beat phrase and compare the first attempt with one corrected release.
Compare two attempts at the same bass line and identify whether unequal releases obscure its support.
Identify whether a held key masks the counted breath and compare your first phrase with a corrected release.
Compare two attempts at the same chord answer and identify whether a ringing strum hides its rest.
Compare two attempts at the same paired-course phrase and identify the crossing that interrupts the pulse.
